title: On-demand state repartitioning is now generally available
body: On-demand state repartitioning is now generally available. You can resize the number of shuffle partitions for a stateful Structured Streaming query or Lakeflow pipeline without losing checkpoint state. See [On-demand state repartitioning for stateful streaming queries](/aws/en/structured-streaming/state-repartitioning).
